desc: The MK-R3000 offers an all-day comfortable 8x32 binocular viewing experience while seamlessly ranging targets without the need to switch between binoculars and rangefinders. Its compact design, measuring just 5.3 inches in length and weighing approximately 780g (excluding the battery), is portable enough to fit in your pocket. Featuring an intuitive six-button layout (four-way key, R key, and M key), it enhances user interaction, providing quick manual adjustments and a streamlined, user-friendly operation. The MK-R3000 features both Ballistics Application Mode (BAM) and standard ranging modes, including Single-point Ranging Mode (SRM) and Continuous Ranging Mode (CRM). It delivers precise range measurements with an accuracy of 1 meter plus 0.1% of the distance for targets beyond 300 meters.
